summary: The Translation Tool (translator) is a Hearthian device built by Hal and the Protagonist that translates Nomai writing within a 3-4 meter range. It is the primary tool the player uses to learn Nomai history and solve lore-based puzzles throughout the solar system.

behavior: The Translation Tool is the newest addition to the Hearthian instruments.
The Translation Tool has a translation range of 3 to 4 meters.
The Translation Tool can only be equipped when the user is inside the range circle of Nomai writing.
Translation processing takes a few seconds after the player clicks the translate button.
The translate button must be held until completion of the translation.
After a first translation, the tool automatically prints results on subsequent sweeps over the same writing.
lore: The Translation Tool was made by a collaboration between the Protagonist and Hal.
The Stranger's language is a previously undiscovered language and cannot be translated by the tool.
Attempting to translate Stranger writing displays 'ERROR: Unknown Language.'
Hal in the museum estimates that translating the Stranger language would require a hundred samples, some form of epigraphical codex, and six months to develop a vague gist.
mechanics: Nomai writing has a recognizable curvy appearance.
Different Nomai handwritings can be distinguished by the precision of the curve, with rougher curves vs. cleaner curves.
Nomai writing is read by starting at the beginning of a base curve, following its path, and recursively reading branching curves before returning to the parent curve.
Branching curves in Nomai writing typically represent different authors in a dialogue.
